executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,re,urllib.request,urllib.error
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
ROOT=Path.cwd();R='reports/research/510300_original_employment_adjustment_cause_objects_v1';OUT=ROOT/R
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def readj(p):return json.loads((ROOT/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save(n,o):
 p=OUT/n;assert not p.exists(),'已有文件不覆盖：'+n
 p.write_text(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
proto=readj(R+'/protocol.json')
for z in proto['parents']:assert sha(ROOT/z['path'])==z['sha256']
targets=[
{'stat_month':'2019-02','url':'https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/sjjd/202302/t20230202_1896148.html','expected_title':'2019年2月中国采购经理指数'},
{'stat_month':'2020-01','url':'https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/sjjd/202302/t20230202_1896298.html','expected_title':'2020年1月中国采购经理指数'}]
save('实际两官方目标_GET前登记.json',{'at':now(),'targets':targets,'fixed_queries_already_completed':2,'retries':0,'authenticated_requests':0,'new_labels':0,'new_fits':0})
(OUT/'raw').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
receipts=[]
for z in targets:
 start=now();raw=None;err=None;code=None;headers={};actual=None
 try:
  req=urllib.request.Request(z['url'],headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
  with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=25) as response:
   raw=response.read();code=response.status;actual=response.geturl()
   headers={k:response.headers.get(k) for k in ['Content-Type','Last-Modified','ETag'] if response.headers.get(k)}
 except Exception as exc:err=type(exc).__name__+': '+str(exc)
 received=now();meta={'stat_month':z['stat_month'],'url':z['url'],'actual_url':actual,'request_started_at':start,'received_at':received,'http_status':code,'headers':headers,'error':err,'retries':0,'authenticated':False}
 if raw is not None:
  f=OUT/'raw'/('nbs_interpretation_'+z['stat_month']+'.html');assert not f.exists();f.write_bytes(raw)
  soup=BeautifulSoup(raw,'html.parser')
  title=soup.title.get_text(' ',strip=True) if soup.title else ''
  normtext=re.sub(r'\s+','',soup.get_text(' '))
  assert z['expected_title'] in re.sub(r'\s+','',title),(z['stat_month'],title)
  clocks=sorted(set(re.findall(r'(?:2019|2020)[/-]\d{1,2}[/-]\d{1,2}\s+\d{1,2}:\d{2}(?::\d{2})?',soup.get_text(' '))))
  blocks=soup.select('.TRS_Editor, .trs_editor, .trs_editor_view, #zoom, #content')
  paras=[]
  for block in blocks:
   for para in block.find_all('p'):
    s=para.get_text(' ',strip=True)
    if s and s not in paras:paras.append(s)
  relevant=[s for s in paras if any(k in s for k in ['制造业','用工','劳动力','调查','春节','疫情'])]
  meta.update({'raw_path':str(f.relative_to(ROOT)).replace('\\','/'),'raw_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(raw),'title':title,'original_institution_title_matched':True,'display_clock_candidates':clocks,'selected_paragraphs':relevant,'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False})
 save('原GET收件_'+z['stat_month']+'.json',meta);receipts.append(meta)
save('实际两官方GET收件汇总.json',receipts)
for z in proto['parents']:assert sha(ROOT/z['path'])==z['sha256']
print(json.dumps({'实际GET':2,'收件':[{'月':z['stat_month'],'HTTP':z['http_status'],'字节':z.get('bytes'),'标题':z.get('title'),'显示钟候选':z.get('display_clock_candidates'),'原制造/问卷相关段':z.get('selected_paragraphs'),'异常':z['error']} for z in receipts],'新金融标签/拟合/账户/源码':0},ensure_ascii=False))
